title: The Old Man of Dream Brook
synopsis: Shen Kuo was a great scientist and polymath during an era of flourishing culture and learning, earning him the appellation “China's Leonardo da Vinci”.

series.title: The Splendor of the Song Dynasty

fullText.simplified:
梦溪丈人——“宋朝达芬奇”的传奇人生

    作为文艺复兴时期的艺术巨匠和博学家，达芬奇广为人知且受人尊敬。比他早400多年的中国北宋，也曾有过这样一位博学的人才，这位全才型科学巨匠就是沈括，自号“梦溪丈人”。
    沈括出生在北宋中期，与著名文学家苏轼年龄相仿。沈括出生于杭州的官员家庭，祖父和父亲都成功通过科举考试获得了官职。因此，沈括家中藏书很多，他从小就对阅读充满兴趣，14岁时就看完了家里所有的书籍。同时，他也喜欢观察自然，在跟随父亲四处做官的时期里，他广泛接触社会和大自然，熟悉了中国南方各地的地理风貌。这样的童年经历让他对地理、科学等学科产生了浓厚兴趣。
    20岁时，沈括的父亲去世。23岁时，沈括依靠父亲曾经的影响力获得了一个小官职。任职期间，他治理水利，开发农田，政绩突出，受到认可。工作结束后，沈括辞去职务，来到哥哥沈披在任的宁国县。在其后的将近十年时间里，他都在准备科举考试。期间，哥哥在宁国县兴修水利工程，他为哥哥献计献策，并为工程做了详细记录。32岁那年，沈括终于在科举考试中崭露头角，随后被调往京城任职。在京城的工作主要负责校对和编撰天文、历法、地理等书籍，这些都是沈括爱好且擅长的，这份工作对他来说是如鱼得水。
    由于工作出色，沈括渐渐得到皇帝的信任。当时北宋正在进行由重要大臣王安石主导的以让国家变强为目的的“王安石变法”。沈括也受到了王安石的赏识，成为变法的支持者与参与者。此后，沈括参与地方治水工程的建设，亲临灾区赈济灾民，还改良武器、参与国防决策工作等。44岁时，沈括出使辽国，与辽国进行谈判，凭借出色的工作能力，使两国关系有所缓和。
    虽然职位越来越高，但政治卷入也越来越深。后来，由于时局变化，沈括与王安石渐行渐远。此外，沈括还卷入了北宋著名文学家苏轼的“乌台诗案”。他被不少人指责，认为正是由于他的背叛，苏轼才会入狱。49岁时，北宋与西北的西夏发生战争，沈括带兵抵抗。在前几场战争中，沈括打了胜仗，但在永乐城之战中兵败，造成重大伤亡。一些历史记录将永乐城兵败的主要原因归咎为沈括决策失误。沈括因兵败被贬官，此后，仕途开始走下坡路。
    58岁时，沈括退出官场，带领家人回到江南，在梦溪园开始隐居生活。隐居期间，沈括开启了他作为科学家的人生，他将毕生所学汇聚于笔，编写了巨作《梦溪笔谈》。
    《梦溪笔谈》是一部百科全书，内容涉及自然科学与社会科学的广泛领域，具有极高的科学价值，堪称中国古代科学史的里程碑。沈括在书中预测了石油必然会获得广泛应用，也指出大量开采可能导致环境问题；还涉及了炼钢、活字印刷、水利等具体工程技术。可以说，要了解中国古代科技，就需要了解沈括和他的《梦溪笔谈》。
    跟热爱学习的达芬奇一样，沈括广泛涉猎，但他的博学没能在当时得到社会的广泛认可；跟勇于解剖尸体的达芬奇一样，沈括敢于打破社会规训，记载和肯定了活字印刷术，只可惜他对科学的贡献没被当时的统治者重视。但是，他为历史留下了《梦溪笔谈》，这使得他成为了中国古代科学史上最耀眼的明星之一。
fullText.traditional:
夢溪丈人——“宋朝達芬奇”的傳奇人生

    作為文藝復興時期的藝術巨匠和博學傢，達芬奇廣為人知且受人尊敬。比他早400多年的中國北宋，也曾有過這樣一位博學的人才，這位全才型科學巨匠就是沈括，自號“夢溪丈人”。
    沈括出生在北宋中期，與著名文學家蘇軾年齡相仿。沈括出生於杭州的官員家庭，祖父和父親都成功通過科舉考試獲得了官職。因此，沈括家中藏書很多，他從小就對閱讀充滿興趣，14歲時就看完了家裡所有的書籍。同時，他也喜歡觀察自然，在跟隨父親四處做官的時期裡，他廣泛接觸社會和大自然，熟悉了中國南方各地的地理風貌。這樣的童年經歷讓他對地理、科學等學科產生了濃厚興趣。
    20歲時，沈括的父親去世。23歲時，沈括依靠父親曾經的影響力獲得了一個小官職。任職期間，他治理水利，開發農田，政績突出，受到認可。工作結束後，沈括辭去職務，來到哥哥沈披在任的寧國縣。在其後的將近十年時間裡，他都在準備科舉考試。期間，哥哥在寧國縣興修水利工程，他為哥哥獻計獻策，並為工程做了詳細記錄。32歲那年，沈括終於在科舉考試中嶄露頭角，隨後被調往京城任職。在京城的工作主要負責校對和編撰天文、曆法、地理等書籍，這些都是沈括愛好且擅長的，這份工作對他來說是如魚得水。
    由於工作出色，沈括漸漸得到皇帝的信任。當時北宋正在進行由重要大臣王安石主導的以讓國家變強為目的的“王安石變法”。沈括也受到了王安石的賞識，成為變法的支持者與參與者。此後，沈括參與地方治水工程的建設，親臨災區賑濟災民，還改良武器、參與國防決策工作等。44歲時，沈括出使遼國，與遼國進行談判，憑借出色的工作能力，使兩國關係有所緩和。
    雖然職位越來越高，但政治捲入也越來越深。後來，由於時局變化，沈括與王安石漸行漸遠。此外，沈括還捲入了北宋著名文學家蘇軾的“烏台詩案”。他被不少人指責，認為正是由於他的背叛，蘇軾才會入獄。49歲時，北宋與西北的西夏發生戰爭，沈括帶兵抵抗。在前幾場戰爭中，沈括打了勝仗，但在永樂城之戰中兵敗，造成重大傷亡。一些歷史記錄將永樂城兵敗的主要原因歸咎為沈括決策失誤。沈括因兵敗被貶官，此後，仕途開始走下坡路。
    58歲時，沈括退出官場，帶領家人回到江南，在夢溪園開始隱居生活。隱居期間，沈括開啟了他作為科學家的人生，他將畢生所學匯聚於筆，編寫了巨作《夢溪筆談》。
    《夢溪筆談》是一部百科全書，內容涉及自然科學與社會科學的廣泛領域，具有極高的科學價值，堪稱中國古代科學史的里程碑。沈括在書中預測了石油必然會獲得廣泛應用，也指出大量開採可能導致環境問題；還涉及了煉鋼、活字印刷、水利等具體工程技術。可以說，要了解中國古代科技，就需要了解沈括和他的《夢溪筆談》。
    跟熱愛學習的達芬奇一樣，沈括廣泛涉獵，但他的博學沒能在當時得到社會的廣泛認可；跟勇於解剖屍體的達芬奇一樣，沈括敢於打破社會規訓，記載和肯定了活字印刷術，只可惜他對科學的貢獻沒被當時的統治者重視。但是，他為歷史留下了《夢溪筆談》，這使得他成為了中國古代科學史上最耀眼的明星之一。

sentences.pinyin: shěn kuò yě shòu dào le wáng ān shí de shǎng shí chéng wéi biàn fǎ de zhī chí zhě yǔ cān yù zhě
sentences.english: .. the “Wang Anshi Reforms” with the aim of strengthening the country.

sentences.simplified: 此后，沈括参与地方治水工程的建设，
sentences.traditional: 此後，沈括參與地方治水工程的建設，
sentences.pinyin: cǐ hòu shěn kuò cān yù dì fāng zhì shuǐ gōng chéng de jiàn shè
sentences.english: Shen Kuo also gained the appreciation of Wang Anshi and became a supporter and participant in the reforms.

sentences.simplified: 亲临灾区赈济灾民，
sentences.traditional: 親臨災區賑濟災民，
sentences.pinyin: qīn lín zāi qū zhèn jì zāi mín
sentences.english: Later, Shen Kuo participated in the construction of local water management projects, ..

sentences.simplified: 还改良武器、参与国防决策工作等。
sentences.traditional: 還改良武器、參與國防決策工作等。
sentences.pinyin: hái gǎi liáng wǔ qì cān yù guó fáng jué cè gōng zuò děng
sentences.english: .. personally visited disaster areas to provide relief to victims, ..

sentences.simplified: 44岁时，沈括出使辽国，与辽国进行谈判，
sentences.traditional: 44歲時，沈括出使遼國，與遼國進行談判，
sentences.pinyin: 3 suì shí shěn kuò chū shǐ liáo guó yǔ liáo guó jìn xíng tán pàn
sentences.english: .. and also improved weapons and participated in national defense decision-making, among other activities.

sentences.simplified: 凭借出色的工作能力，使两国关系有所缓和。
sentences.traditional: 憑借出色的工作能力，使兩國關係有所緩和。
sentences.pinyin: píng jiè chū sè de gōng zuò néng lì shǐ liǎng guó guān xi yǒu suǒ huǎn hé
sentences.english: At the age of forty-four, Shen Kuo was sent as an envoy to the state of Liao to conduct negotiations.
Thanks to his outstanding abilities, relations between the two states were eased.

sentences.simplified: 虽然职位越来越高，但政治卷入也越来越深。
sentences.traditional: 雖然職位越來越高，但政治捲入也越來越深。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán zhí wèi yuè lái yuè gāo dàn zhèng zhì juǎn rù yě yuè lái yuè shēn

sentences.simplified: 后来，由于时局变化，沈括与王安石渐行渐远。
sentences.traditional: 後來，由於時局變化，沈括與王安石漸行漸遠。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái yóu yú shí jú biàn huà shěn kuò yǔ wáng ān shí jiàn xíng jiàn yuǎn
sentences.english: Although his official rank kept rising, he became increasingly entangled in politics.

sentences.simplified: 此外，沈括还卷入了北宋著名文学家苏轼的“乌台诗案”。
sentences.traditional: 此外，沈括還捲入了北宋著名文學家蘇軾的“烏台詩案”。
sentences.pinyin: cǐ wài shěn kuò hái juǎn rù le běi sòng zhù míng wén xué jiā sū shì de wū tái shī àn
sentences.english: Later, due to changes in the political situation, Shen Kuo and Wang Anshi gradually drifted apart.

sentences.simplified: 他被不少人指责，认为正是由于他的背叛，苏轼才会入狱。
sentences.traditional: 他被不少人指責，認為正是由於他的背叛，蘇軾才會入獄。
sentences.pinyin: tā bèi bù shǎo rén zhǐ zé rèn wéi zhèng shì yóu yú tā de bèi pàn sū shì cái huì rù yù
sentences.english: In addition, Shen Kuo was also involved in the “Crow Terrace Poetry Case” of the famous Northern Song writer Su Shi.

sentences.simplified: 49岁时，北宋与西北的西夏发生战争，沈括带兵抵抗。
sentences.traditional: 49歲時，北宋與西北的西夏發生戰爭，沈括帶兵抵抗。
sentences.pinyin: 3 suì shí běi sòng yǔ xī běi de xī xià fā shēng zhàn zhēng shěn kuò dài bīng dǐ kàng
sentences.english: He was accused by many people, who believed that it was his betrayal that led to Su Shi’s imprisonment.

sentences.simplified: 在前几场战争中，沈括打了胜仗，但在永乐城之战中兵败，造成重大伤亡。
sentences.traditional: 在前幾場戰爭中，沈括打了勝仗，但在永樂城之戰中兵敗，造成重大傷亡。
sentences.pinyin: zài qián jǐ cháng zhàn zhēng zhōng shěn kuò dǎ le shèng zhàng dàn zài yǒng lè chéng zhī zhàn zhōng bīng bài zào chéng zhòng dà shāng wáng
sentences.english: At the age of forty-nine, during the war between the Northern Song and the Western Xia in the northwest, Shen Kuo led troops to resist.

sentences.simplified: 一些历史记录将永乐城兵败的主要原因归咎为沈括决策失误。
sentences.traditional: 一些歷史記錄將永樂城兵敗的主要原因歸咎為沈括決策失誤。
sentences.pinyin: yì xiē lì shǐ jì lù jiāng yǒng lè chéng bīng bài de zhǔ yào yuán yīn guī jiù wéi shěn kuò jué cè shī wù
sentences.english: In previous battles, Shen Kuo won victories, but in the Battle of Yongle City, he was defeated, resulting in significant casualties.

sentences.simplified: 沈括因兵败被贬官，此后，仕途开始走下坡路。
sentences.traditional: 沈括因兵敗被貶官，此後，仕途開始走下坡路。
sentences.pinyin: shěn kuò yīn bīng bài bèi biǎn guān cǐ hòu shì tú kāi shǐ zǒu xià pō lù
sentences.english: Some historical records attribute the main reason for the defeat at Yongle City to Shen Kuo’s decision-making errors.
Because of the military defeat, Shen Kuo was demoted, and after that, his official career began to decline.

sentences.simplified: 58岁时，沈括退出官场，带领家人回到江南，
sentences.traditional: 58歲時，沈括退出官場，帶領家人回到江南，
sentences.pinyin: 3 suì shí shěn kuò tuì chū guān chǎng dài lǐng jiā rén huí dào jiāng nán

sentences.simplified: 在梦溪园开始隐居生活。
sentences.traditional: 在夢溪園開始隱居生活。
sentences.pinyin: zài mèng xī yuán kāi shǐ yǐn jū shēng huó
sentences.english: At the age of fifty-eight, Shen Kuo retired from officialdom, led his family back to Jiangnan, ..

sentences.simplified: 隐居期间，沈括开启了他作为科学家的人生，
sentences.traditional: 隱居期間，沈括開啟了他作為科學家的人生，
sentences.pinyin: yǐn jū qī jiān shěn kuò kāi qǐ le tā zuò wéi kē xué jiā de rén shēng
sentences.english: .. and began a reclusive life in the Dream Brook Garden.

sentences.simplified: 他将毕生所学汇聚于笔，编写了巨作《梦溪笔谈》。
sentences.traditional: 他將畢生所學匯聚於筆，編寫了巨作《夢溪筆談》。
sentences.pinyin: tā jiāng bì shēng suǒ xué huì jù yú bǐ biān xiě le jù zuò mèng xī bǐ tán
sentences.english: During his seclusion, Shen Kuo embarked on his life as a scientist.
He compiled all his lifelong knowledge into writing and authored the monumental work “Brush Talks from Dream Brook”.

sentences.simplified: 《梦溪笔谈》是一部百科全书，内容涉及自然科学与社会科学的广泛领域，
sentences.traditional: 《夢溪筆談》是一部百科全書，內容涉及自然科學與社會科學的廣泛領域，
sentences.pinyin: mèng xī bǐ tán shì yí bù bǎi kē quán shū nèi róng shè jí zì rán kē xué yǔ shè huì kē xué de guǎng fàn lǐng yù

sentences.simplified: 具有极高的科学价值，堪称中国古代科学史的里程碑。
sentences.traditional: 具有極高的科學價值，堪稱中國古代科學史的里程碑。
sentences.pinyin: jù yǒu jí gāo de kē xué jià zhí kān chēng zhōng guó gǔ dài kē xué shǐ de lǐ chéng bēi
sentences.english: “Brush Talks from Dream Brook” is an encyclopedia that covers a wide range of fields in natural and social sciences.

sentences.simplified: 沈括在书中预测了石油必然会获得广泛应用，
sentences.traditional: 沈括在書中預測了石油必然會獲得廣泛應用，
sentences.pinyin: shěn kuò zài shū zhōng yù cè le shí yóu bì rán huì huò dé guǎng fàn yìng yòng
sentences.english: It holds extremely high scientific value and can be regarded as a milestone in the history of ancient Chinese science.

sentences.simplified: 也指出大量开采可能导致环境问题；
sentences.traditional: 也指出大量開採可能導致環境問題；
sentences.pinyin: yě zhǐ chū dà liàng kāi cǎi kě néng dǎo zhì huán jìng wèn tí
sentences.english: Shen Kuo predicted in his book that petroleum would inevitably gain widespread use, ..

sentences.simplified: 还涉及了炼钢、活字印刷、水利等具体工程技术。
sentences.traditional: 還涉及了煉鋼、活字印刷、水利等具體工程技術。
sentences.pinyin: hái shè jí le liàn gāng huó zì yìn shuā shuǐ lì děng jù tǐ gōng chéng jì shù
sentences.english: .. and also pointed out that extensive extraction could lead to environmental issues.

sentences.simplified: 可以说，要了解中国古代科技，就需要了解沈括和他的《梦溪笔谈》。
sentences.traditional: 可以說，要了解中國古代科技，就需要了解沈括和他的《夢溪筆談》。
sentences.pinyin: kě yǐ shuō yào liǎo jiě zhōng guó gǔ dài kē jì jiù xū yào liǎo jiě shěn kuò hé tā de mèng xī bǐ tán
sentences.english: He also touched on specific engineering technologies such as steelmaking, movable type printing, and water conservancy.
It can be said that to understand ancient Chinese technology, one needs to understand Shen Kuo and his “Brush Talks from Dream Brook”.

sentences.simplified: 跟热爱学习的达芬奇一样，沈括广泛涉猎，
sentences.traditional: 跟熱愛學習的達芬奇一樣，沈括廣泛涉獵，
sentences.pinyin: gēn rè ài xué xí de dá fēn qí yí yàng shěn kuò guǎng fàn shè liè

sentences.simplified: 但他的博学没能在当时得到社会的广泛认可；
sentences.traditional: 但他的博學沒能在當時得到社會的廣泛認可；
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā de bó xué méi néng zài dāng shí dé dào shè huì de guǎng fàn rèn kě
sentences.english: Like Leonardo da Vinci, who loved learning, Shen Kuo had a wide range of interests.

sentences.simplified: 跟勇于解剖尸体的达芬奇一样，
sentences.traditional: 跟勇於解剖屍體的達芬奇一樣，
sentences.pinyin: gēn yǒng yú jiě pōu shī tǐ de dá fēn qí yí yàng
sentences.english: But his erudition did not receive widespread recognition in society at the time.

sentences.simplified: 沈括敢于打破社会规训，记载和肯定了活字印刷术，
sentences.traditional: 沈括敢於打破社會規訓，記載和肯定了活字印刷術，
sentences.pinyin: shěn kuò gǎn yú dǎ pò shè huì guī xùn jì zǎi hé kěn dìng le huó zì yìn shuā shù
sentences.english: Like da Vinci, who was brave enough to dissect corpses, ..

sentences.simplified: 只可惜他对科学的贡献没被当时的统治者重视。
sentences.traditional: 只可惜他對科學的貢獻沒被當時的統治者重視。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ kě xī tā duì kē xué de gòng xiàn méi bèi dāng shí de tǒng zhì zhě zhòng shì
sentences.english: .. Shen Kuo dared to break social conventions, documenting and affirming the technique of movable type printing.

sentences.simplified: 但是，他为历史留下了《梦溪笔谈》，
sentences.traditional: 但是，他為歷史留下了《夢溪筆談》，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì tā wèi lì shǐ liú xià le mèng xī bǐ tán
sentences.english: Unfortunately, his contributions to science were not valued by the rulers of his time.

sentences.simplified: 这使得他成为了中国古代科学史上最耀眼的明星之一。
sentences.traditional: 這使得他成為了中國古代科學史上最耀眼的明星之一。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shǐ de tā chéng wéi le zhōng guó gǔ dài kē xué shǐ shang zuì yào yǎn de míng xīng zhī yī
sentences.english: However, he left behind “Brush Talks from Dream Brook” for history.

sentence_translations: The Old Man of Dream Brook: The Legendary Life of the “Da Vinci of the Song Dynasty”
As a great artist and polymath of the Renaissance period, Leonardo da Vinci is widely known and revered.
More than 400 years before him, during China’s Northern Song dynasty, there was also such a man of broad learning and talent.
This all-around scientific master was Shen Kuo, who called himself “The Old Man of Dream Brook”.
Shen Kuo was born in the mid-Northern Song period and was about the same age as the famous literary figure Su Shi.
Shen Kuo was born into a family of officials in Hangzhou, ..
.. with both his grandfather and father successfully passing the imperial examination to obtain official positions.
As a result, Shen Kuo’s home had a large collection of books, and from an early age, he developed a strong interest in reading.
By the age of fourteen, he had finished reading all the books in his house.
At the same time, he also enjoyed observing nature.
During the period when he followed his father around on various official postings, he was widely exposed to society and nature, ..
.. becoming familiar with the geographical features of various regions in southern China.
These childhood experiences fostered in him a strong interest in subjects such as geography and science.
When he was twenty years old, Shen Kuo’s father passed away.
At the age of twenty-three, Shen Kuo obtained a minor official post by relying on the influence once held by his late father.
During his tenure, he managed water conservancy projects and developed farmland, ..
.. achieving notable accomplishments that earned him recognition.
After completing his work, ..
.. Shen Kuo resigned from his post and went to Ningguo County, where his elder brother Shen Pi was serving as an official.
For nearly ten years thereafter, he was preparing for the imperial examinations.
During this period, his elder brother was engaged in water conservancy projects in Ningguo County.
He offered suggestions and strategies to his elder brother and kept detailed records of the projects.
At the age of thirty-two, Shen Kuo finally made his mark in the imperial examination, ..
.. and was subsequently transferred to the capital to take up an official post.
In the capital, his work mainly involved proofreading and compiling books on astronomy, calendars, geography, and related subjects.
These were all areas that Shen Kuo was passionate about and excelled in, so he felt completely in his element in this work.
Due to his outstanding work, Shen Kuo gradually gained the emperor’s trust.
Led by the prominent minister Wang Anshi, at the time the Northern Song was carrying out ..
.. the “Wang Anshi Reforms” with the aim of strengthening the country.
Shen Kuo also gained the appreciation of Wang Anshi and became a supporter and participant in the reforms.
Later, Shen Kuo participated in the construction of local water management projects, ..
.. personally visited disaster areas to provide relief to victims, ..
.. and also improved weapons and participated in national defense decision-making, among other activities.
At the age of forty-four, Shen Kuo was sent as an envoy to the state of Liao to conduct negotiations.
Thanks to his outstanding abilities, relations between the two states were eased.
Although his official rank kept rising, he became increasingly entangled in politics.
Later, due to changes in the political situation, Shen Kuo and Wang Anshi gradually drifted apart.
In addition, Shen Kuo was also involved in the “Crow Terrace Poetry Case” of the famous Northern Song writer Su Shi.
He was accused by many people, who believed that it was his betrayal that led to Su Shi’s imprisonment.
At the age of forty-nine, during the war between the Northern Song and the Western Xia in the northwest, Shen Kuo led troops to resist.
In previous battles, Shen Kuo won victories, but in the Battle of Yongle City, he was defeated, resulting in significant casualties.
Some historical records attribute the main reason for the defeat at Yongle City to Shen Kuo’s decision-making errors.
Because of the military defeat, Shen Kuo was demoted, and after that, his official career began to decline.
At the age of fifty-eight, Shen Kuo retired from officialdom, led his family back to Jiangnan, ..
.. and began a reclusive life in the Dream Brook Garden.
During his seclusion, Shen Kuo embarked on his life as a scientist.
He compiled all his lifelong knowledge into writing and authored the monumental work “Brush Talks from Dream Brook”.
“Brush Talks from Dream Brook” is an encyclopedia that covers a wide range of fields in natural and social sciences.
It holds extremely high scientific value and can be regarded as a milestone in the history of ancient Chinese science.
Shen Kuo predicted in his book that petroleum would inevitably gain widespread use, ..
.. and also pointed out that extensive extraction could lead to environmental issues.
He also touched on specific engineering technologies such as steelmaking, movable type printing, and water conservancy.
It can be said that to understand ancient Chinese technology, one needs to understand Shen Kuo and his “Brush Talks from Dream Brook”.
Like Leonardo da Vinci, who loved learning, Shen Kuo had a wide range of interests.
But his erudition did not receive widespread recognition in society at the time.
Like da Vinci, who was brave enough to dissect corpses, ..
.. Shen Kuo dared to break social conventions, documenting and affirming the technique of movable type printing.
Unfortunately, his contributions to science were not valued by the rulers of his time.
However, he left behind “Brush Talks from Dream Brook” for history.
This made him one of the brightest stars in the history of ancient Chinese science.
